message.content: When prompting for a file-type option that has a default value, the prompt displays the default’s full representation (e.g., the file object) instead of just the file path, making the prompt confusing.
message.reasoning: We need to write a concise problem statement describing the externally observable bug. The PR title says "Formatting file option prompting to path only". PR body references issue #914. The patch shows changes in termui.py to format default values for prompts, specifically for file-type options. The bug seems to be that when prompting for a file option with a default value, the prompt shows the entire default object representation (like the file object itself) instead of just the file path. The fix adds a function _format_default that extracts the name attribute for IO objects and LazyFile, showing the path only. So the symptom: when a user has a command-line option that is a file type with a default value, the prompt message displays the default in an unhelpful way (like showing the file object representation) instead of the file path. The problem statement should focus on what the user sees incorrectly.
